title: DF Army Public School Campus, Rawalpindi | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: DF Army Public School Campus, located in Rawalpindi, Pakistan. Address: Rawal Road, Rawalpindi. Google Maps location: https://www.google.com/maps?q=33.60270459342268,73.0873128684933. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Rawalpindi as the city.
